meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 此技能让Claude制作短的设计感动画：文字弹动、数字滚动、图表、Logo、地图等。它会先规划，按需搜索素材，组装动画，检查无误后渲染成MP4或透明视频；渲染前会征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你想做一个简短、无旁白、以动效为主的设计（如动态文字、数字、图表等），或被 /hyperframes 判断为本类任务时触发。更长或带旁白会走 /general-video。

say.text: 把“你好世界”做成逐字弹出动画，10秒内。
say.note: 它会先生成计划并询问是否先预览。

say.text: 把这份季度销量做成动态增长柱状图。
say.note: 数据图表动画，会先检查是否需要搜索素材。

say.text: 用我的Logo做一个5秒的品牌片头。
say.note: 若Logo来自figma链接，会先导入资产。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude craft short design-led motion graphics: kinetic type, count-ups, charts, logo reveals. It plans, fetches assets if required, assembles the piece, then renders MP4 or transparent video after asking your approval.
howto.when_en: When you request a short, unnarrated motion design (often under 10s), e.g. animated text, stats or charts, and /hyperframes routes the task here. Longer/narrated pieces go to /general-video.

say_en.text: Animate the phrase 'Hello world' letter by letter, within 10 seconds.
say_en.note: It will plan and ask whether to preview first.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly sales table into an animated bar chart.
say_en.note: Plans the chart and checks if external assets are needed.

say_en.text: Make a 5-second logo sting using my logo.
say_en.note: If the source is a Figma link, it's imported first.
